description:
Tae-eun ends up joining a reality show with Ji-han—his ex and occasional partner—and Sae-myeong, a self-proclaimed fan. As the three live and film together, the tension between them grows, and complicated emotions begin to surface. When hidden relationships and desires are unexpectedly revealed, their situation spirals into an intense mix of rivalry and attraction that blurs the line between performance and reality.
